messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: hosted-us-east p95 latency > 5s for /v1/generate, request queue 11.8k, GPU pool util 98%. Autoscaler attempted scale but hit MAX_NODES.
Priya (oncall): grabbing this. starting timeline and paging eng-infra.
Alex (infra): seeing the same in dashboards — provisioner logs show repeated 'quota_exceeded' from cloud provider on new instance create.
Maya (sre): linking runbook: https://runbooks.internal/provisioner/quota-fail 
Priya (oncall): customers_reporting: 5 active incidents via support, several 504s. marking SEV2 for now.
Carlos (platform): can we flip routing to fallback model set? We have smaller CPU fallback group that serves but slower.
Alex (infra): tried increasing autoscaler.max_nodes from 200 -> 300, cloud API returns 403 Quota limit.
ops-runbook-bot: Recommended mitigation step 1: enable global request shed at 80% capacity for non-critical routes. Run: `./ops/shutdown_noncritical_routes.sh --target=us-east --pct=80`
Priya (oncall): executing shed for marketing and background routes now.
Priya (oncall): `!exec ./ops/shutdown_noncritical_routes.sh --target=us-east --pct=80` -> completed. queue dropped to ~8.2k, p95 improved to ~3.2s.
Maya (sre): p99 still elevated near 18s for pinned customers. we need targeted fallbacks for high qps clients.
Carlos (platform): enabling model-variant fallback for large requests: route policy -> fallback_small_model. Doing a gradual rollout (10% -> 50%).
Alex (infra): provisioning attempts still failing. Cloud quota team says increase requires ticket. opened ticket #CLD-7891, ETA 2h.
Priya (oncall): added note to status page draft: "Experiencing elevated latency in US-East due to capacity limits; we are throttling non-critical traffic and enabling fallbacks." Getting approval from comms.
Maya (sre): temp mitigations summary: 1) route-level shedding done; 2) model-variant fallback enabled to 30%; 3) CPU fallback pool enabled for small requests. p95 -> 2.1s, p99 -> 9.8s, queue -> 4.5k.
Carlos (platform): observed some clients still sending huge fanout requests (batch size spikes). Can we apply per-client rate-limits for top 10 noisy API keys?
Priya (oncall): listing top offending API keys now.
Priya (oncall): `GET /internal/metrics/top_api_keys?window=15m` -> keys: key-ACME-1, key-PLATFORM-42, key-EXPT-9. Applying soft 20% throttle to those three.
Alex (infra): throttle applied. immediate drop in new queue ingress ~25%.
ops-runbook-bot: Recommended mitigation step 2: schedule graceful eviction of long-waiting requests > 60s. Run: `./ops/evict_long_waiters.sh --threshold=60`
Priya (oncall): running eviction. Notifying support to retry for impacted customers.
Maya (sre): eviction freed ~900 slots. p99 down to ~6.5s.
Carlos (platform): adding follow-ups: (a) request quota increase ticket escalated; (b) postmortem owner assigned: Maya; (c) consider autoscaler change: fail-open to burst into CPU pool sooner.
Priya (oncall): handing off to overnight oncall Alex in 30m. leaving summary: autoscaler blocked by cloud quota; mitigations: route shedding, model fallbacks, per-client throttles, evict long waiters. support notified.
Alex (infra): acknowledged handoff. will keep watch and follow up on CLD-7891.
Maya (sre): filing initial incident page: https://incidents.internal/1769456789 — includes timelines, customer impact, mitigations, next steps.
Priya (oncall): thanks team. tagging @comms for status update. :pray:
Incident Bot: Incident update: status MOVING -> STABILIZING. Metrics: queue 3.9k, p95 1.9s, p99 5.8s.
Priya (oncall): closing chat for now; will re-open if regression.
Alex (infra): follow-up todo for tomorrow: pre-approve quota increases in cloud console, add autoscaler fallback to CPU at 50% threshold, improve alerting to surface quota_exceeded earlier.
Maya (sre): noted. postmortem draft due in 72h."
